decisions.reason: Because it builds directly on the firm's existing automation and monitoring capabilities and the firm has strong in-house R&D and research links, management is likely to view early market feedback as learnable and worth refining rather than exiting.

A web tool for weir dimensioning fits closely with the firm's engineering and software base for water infrastructure, so an expanding R&D-active firm would usually retain it as a complementary digital offering.

This product is close to the firm's established monitoring and efficiency-oriented infrastructure business, and its absorptive capacity from proprietary know-how, university cooperation, and project experience makes continuation more likely than withdrawal.
